mentions.name: PicPickr
mentions.description: A desktop app built with Electron and React that helps newlywed couples quickly sort thousands of wedding photos with a Tinder-style swipe UI. It is offline-first, fully private, and offers one-click export of selected pictures.
mentions.problem: Sorting thousands of wedding photos after a wedding is overwhelming for non-photographers, who end up dragging and dropping photos from one folder to another.
mentions.audience: Newlywed couples and other non-photographer folks who need to sort thousands of wedding photos
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on PicPickr.

It is a desktop app built with Electron and React. I built to help newlywed couples to quickly sort thousands of wedding photos with a Tinder style swipe UI. It is offline first, fully private, and offers one click export of your selected pictures.
